Philippine Tourism Statistical Classification System (PTSCS)

Source: R/ptscs.R
get_ptscs.Rd

Returns a PTSCS list with columns id, category_id, description (the category name) and keywords.

Usage

get_ptscs(type = c("industries", "products"))

Arguments

type

Character. Which list to return: "industries" (default), the tourism characteristic industries, or "products", the tourism characteristic products. The two lists reuse the same codes.

Value

A data frame of PTSCS classifications. For industries, keywords is a list column of the comma-separated keywords; for products, it is the original “Includes ...” text, unchanged.

References

https://psa.gov.ph/classification/ptsc

Examples

ptscs <- get_ptscs()
ptscs_products <- get_ptscs(type = "products")
